head_commit.message:
refactor(contracts)!: split Hexalith.Projects.UI.Contracts from the packable Contracts package

Story 6.8 (AD-16, DW-55). The FrontComposer projections, vocabulary
descriptors, ProjectsFrontComposerDomain and the SourceTools generator move
to the new non-packable Hexalith.Projects.UI.Contracts project, under their
unchanged Hexalith.Projects.Contracts.Ui namespace. Contracts keeps the wire
vocabulary enums with their JSON names unchanged and no longer references
FrontComposer, Microsoft.AspNetCore.App, Fluxor or Fluent UI, so CLI and MCP
consumers pull no Blazor dependency.

Badge slots now come from an explicit table in ProjectVocabularyDescriptors,
pinned to the pre-split values by a golden test. The package dependency gate
rejects FrontComposer references in Contracts and applies the SourceTools
rule to UI.Contracts. The inspect gate targets UI.Contracts and fails when
its inputs are absent. tools/release-packages.json carries the slimmer
Contracts, Projects, Client and Testing graphs, and DW-55 is closed.

BREAKING CHANGE: the Hexalith.Projects.Contracts package no longer ships the
FrontComposer projection and descriptor types (the 12 *Projection types,
ProjectVocabularyDescriptors, VocabularyDescriptor, ProjectsFrontComposerDomain,
ProjectMaintenancePanelState and ProjectMaintenancePanelStates), the
[ProjectionBadge] metadata on its vocabulary enums, or its
Microsoft.AspNetCore.App, Fluxor and Fluent UI dependencies. Its
Hexalith.Conversations.Contracts dependency is now 2.0.0, as selected by the
current Builds catalog.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
